root_cause: The incorrect condition `if(n - i < m - j)` causes premature termination and thus results in an incorrect answer when the array `b` cannot be fully processed before `a`, which should not lead to an immediate return of -1.
suggestion: Suggestion 1. Remove the incorrect termination condition - The line `if(n - i < m - j){pw.print(-1);return;}` should be completely removed as it causes early termination of the loop incorrectly based on an optimization that is not needed.
